CREATE TABLE #TEMP
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) RN,  
    'CREATE VIEW EDS.'+TABLE_NAME+' AS
    SELECT CONCAT(''SELECT'', STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(max), ISNULL(COLUMN_NAME,''N/A'')), '','')  
    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
    WHERE TABLE_NAME = '''+TABLE_NAME+''' 
    AND TABLE_SCHEMA = '''+TABLE_SCHEMA+'''
    , '' WHERE SCD_END_DATE = ''''9999-12-31''
    )' AS QUERY FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'EDS' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('ATM_CLIENT')
SELECT * FROM #TEMP

DECLARE @i int = 1, @max int = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TEMP);

WHILE @i<=@max
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(max) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #TEMP WHERE RN = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Sequence
,       [name]
,       'WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H = ''D''
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,''F-'','''') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H <> ''D''
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)
